decision_tasks.title: Choose between two job offers
decision_tasks.description: Help the user choose between two job offers by comparing pay, growth, stability, learning, and lifestyle fit.

inputs.name: user_preferences
inputs.description: Weights for what the user cares about most.

inputs.name: time_horizon_years
inputs.description: How far ahead the user wants to think when comparing options.

context.notes: Use explainable reasoning and reference these factors explicitly in the explanation.

goals.name: maximize_fit
goals.description: Maximize alignment between the chosen offer and the user’s preferences.

goals.name: reduce_regret
goals.description: Minimize the chance the user feels they ignored an important factor.

success_criteria: All key factors are explicitly mentioned in the explanation.
User sees at least one clear recommendation plus an alternative with trade-offs.
Outputs include a short, bullet-style summary the user can save or share.

decision_tasks.title: Plan savings for a target goal
decision_tasks.description: Guide the user to plan monthly savings and trade-offs to reach a specific financial goal by a target date.

inputs.name: goal_amount
inputs.description: Total amount the user wants to reach.

inputs.name: target_date
inputs.description: When the user wants to reach the goal.

inputs.name: current_savings
inputs.description: Current amount already saved toward the goal.

inputs.name: risk_tolerance
inputs.description: Risk appetite for using higher-yield but volatile instruments.

context.notes: Explain trade-offs between saving rate, time horizon, and lifestyle impact.

goals.name: reach_goal
goals.description: Ensure the plan reaches or exceeds the target amount by the target date under reasonable assumptions.

goals.name: maintain_quality_of_life
goals.description: Avoid unrealistic cuts to essential spending.

success_criteria: Plan includes a clear monthly saving recommendation and timeline.
User sees at least one alternative scenario (e.g., later date or smaller goal).
Explanations highlight key risks and assumptions.

decision_tasks.title: Decide how to fix a failing test suite
decision_tasks.description: Help a developer choose the best next actions to fix failing tests in a large codebase.

inputs.name: failing_test_names
inputs.description: List of failing tests or test files.

inputs.name: failure_categories
inputs.description: Optional mapping of failures to categories (e.g. NL Dev, CLI & Services).

inputs.name: time_available_minutes
inputs.description: Approximate time the developer has for this session.

context.notes: Use documentation files like DOCUMENTATION_INDEX and QUICK_FIX_GUIDE as references for recommended fix order.

goals.name: maximize_passes_in_time_window
goals.description: Fix as many tests as possible within the available time.

goals.name: prioritize_impact
goals.description: Focus on failures that unlock the most value or reduce the most risk.

success_criteria: Developer receives a prioritized list of categories and tests to tackle.
Each recommendation links to relevant docs or examples when possible.
Plan fits within the stated time window.
